about: The Innotive Conferences welcomes you to the International Conference on Public Health scheduled to be held on October 14th, 2026 under the theme Advancing Public Health Through Innovation, Equity, and Global Collaboration.

Our premier event dedicated to the latest developments in the field of public health is set to bring together leading experts, researchers, and practitioners from around the globe. The influential gathering will serve as a platform for sharing groundbreaking research, discussion on innovative strategies, and addressing challenges in the realm of public health. By providing a dynamic space for professionals, researchers, and thought leaders to converge, our platform plays a pivotal role in shaping the future landscape of medicine, science, and technology.

Our platform actively contributes to the dissemination of cutting-edge research, the integration of novel technologies, and the translation of scientific knowledge into real-world applications for the betterment of society.

guidelines.title: Oral Presentation Guidelines
items: After registering for the webinar, the user will receive a meeting invite containing a personalized user ID for accessing the webinar. Please check the junk mail folder if the email is not visible in the inbox.
Please follow the provided steps to join the webinar 1 or 2 days before the event to avoid any potential technical issues on the day of the event.
Please join the webinar 30 minutes early in order to minimize any potential last-minute issues.
Oral presenters will be allocated 20 minutes time for their presentation and 5 minutes for questions and answers. 20 slides are optimal, allowing 1 minute per slide.
Please ensure that your device meets the system requirements for running this application.
It is recommended to attach an external device for audio.
If the user is experiencing audio issues, they should check their application audio settings and their computer speakers.
The user should find a quiet location with good network access and no disturbances in order to sit.

Please mute your audio while others are presenting. Attendees who would like to ask questions or engage in discussion are kindly requested to raise their hands. The host will unmute them at the conclusion of the talk.

guidelines.title: Poster Presentation Guidelines
items: To ensure visual effectiveness of your poster, use large lettering and a minimum of text.

faqs.q: Where does the webinar take place?
faqs.a: ICPH2026 is organizing through ZOOM platform followed by UK timings.

faqs.q: What language is the webinar held in?
faqs.a: The official language of the conference is English and all sessions will be held in English language.

faqs.q: How much time will be given for an oral presenter?
faqs.a: Each Oral Presenter will have 20-25 minutes for presentation including Q/A session.

faqs.q: How much time will be given for a poster presenter?
faqs.a: Each Poster Presenter will have 10-15 minutes for presentation including Q/A session.
Send us your abstracts as per the sample template in Abstract Submission page or you can directly email to program co-ordinator email: public-health@innotiveconferences.com

faqs.q: Where do I go to submit an abstract?
faqs.a: You may submit proposals online via our Abstract Submission Portal or you can directly email to program co-ordinator.
Registration for International Conference on Public Health opens on 31st July, 2026

faqs.q: Where do I go to register for the ICPH2026?
faqs.a: You can register for the conference via our online registration form.

faqs.q: What does my registration cost cover?
a: Get your abstract published with the DOI.

faqs.q: Do you have any template for paper submission?
faqs.a: Yes, we have a template for abstract submission. Please download from this [link](@abstractTemplate).

faqs.q: When will I know if my paper has been accepted?
faqs.a: Once you submit the abstract, we will let you know the acceptance in 2-3 business days. If you are not receiving the acceptance of abstract, please contact: public-health@innotiveconferences.com

faqs.q: When should I submit my final presentation?
faqs.a: You have to send your final presentation through power point to the Program Co-Ordinator before one week of the webinar.
